c141742123.notes: Small brass commemorative plaque on a blue plinth in Parque Rafael Campo, Sonsonate, with the cathedral and a bust behind. Only the header and project title are transcribed; the rest of the plaque (dedication text, donor families, mayor 'JOSE ROBERTO AQUINO RUIZ', two columns of council names, date) is too small to read reliably. Crest legend 'SONSONATE' and the national seal ring text are tiny.
